symbolDescription: Props for PdfViewer. Every piece of state supports the value / defaultValue / onChange trio.

optionDescriptions.annotationLayer: Clickable links: internal links navigate, external links open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer".
optionDescriptions.aria-label: Accessible name of the viewer region.
optionDescriptions.compactBreakpoint: Viewport width (px) below which the compact layout applies: less padding, and hiddenWhenCompact actions hidden outside fullscreen.
optionDescriptions.defaultPage: Initial page while uncontrolled, and the page every new document opens on.
optionDescriptions.defaultScale: Initial scale while uncontrolled; also the reset-zoom target and the scale at which fitting applies.
optionDescriptions.fetcher: Replaces fetch entirely, e.g. with an authenticated HTTP client.
optionDescriptions.fileName: Download file name. Default: a File’s name, the URL’s last .pdf segment, else document.pdf.
optionDescriptions.fitMode: At the default scale, fill the width (width) or fit the whole page (page). Zooming away shows the page at true size.
optionDescriptions.fitWidthAtDefaultScale: At the default scale, shrink the page to the available width.
optionDescriptions.fullscreen: Controlled fullscreen state. Passing it selects fullscreenMode="controlled" unless a mode is set.
optionDescriptions.fullscreenMode: controlled: layout only, the parent presents fullscreen (e.g. in its own dialog). native: the browser Fullscreen API on the viewer root, falling back to overlay. overlay: a fixed full-viewport layer with a focus trap; Esc closes it.
optionDescriptions.getHttpErrorMessage: Builds the HTTP_ERROR message. Return undefined for the default: an RFC 7807 detail, then title, then a JSON string body, then Failed to fetch PDF: {status} {statusText}.
optionDescriptions.keyboardShortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts while focus is inside the viewer.
optionDescriptions.labels: Overrides for any visible string or accessible name. Keep the object stable (e.g. at module scope).
optionDescriptions.layout: One page at a time or vertical scrolling through all pages. Only the visible pages ±1 are rendered; the page indicator follows the scroll position.
optionDescriptions.locale: BCP 47 locale for number formatting, e.g. hu-HU.
optionDescriptions.maxCanvasPixels: Canvas pixel budget per page (4096 × 4096). Above it, resolution degrades gracefully instead of failing.
optionDescriptions.onDownload: Before saving; data holds the already-loaded bytes. Return false to handle the download yourself.
optionDescriptions.onError: Every failure except aborted loads, cancelled renders and HTTP errors handled by onHttpError.
optionDescriptions.onHttpError: Called for non-2xx responses. Return true when handled (e.g. after redirecting to sign-in): the viewer shows its empty state and does not call onError.
optionDescriptions.onPrint: Before printing. Return false to handle printing yourself.
optionDescriptions.page: Controlled 1-based page. Out-of-range values are clamped and reported through onPageChange.
optionDescriptions.pageInput: Editable page number in the toolbar.
optionDescriptions.password: Password for encrypted documents. Changing it reloads the document.
optionDescriptions.passwordPrompt: Ask for the password of encrypted documents instead of reporting PASSWORD_REQUIRED.
optionDescriptions.pdfjsOptions: Per-instance getDocument overrides such as cMapUrl, standardFontDataUrl or verbosity. Source-related options are managed by the viewer.
optionDescriptions.printMode: render prints through a hidden iframe, with progress and Cancel; open-url opens the PDF in a new tab.
optionDescriptions.renderEmpty: Replaces the view shown without a source.
optionDescriptions.renderError: Replaces the document and page error views.
optionDescriptions.renderToolbar: Replaces the toolbar. Render <PdfToolbar api={api} /> inside to reuse parts.
optionDescriptions.requestInit: Extra fetch options for URL sources: headers, credentials, mode, …
optionDescriptions.rotation: Controlled clockwise rotation, added to each page’s intrinsic rotation.
optionDescriptions.scale: Controlled scale: 1 = 100%, one PDF point per CSS pixel.
optionDescriptions.scaleStep: Increment of the zoom buttons and the + / - keys.
optionDescriptions.search: Find bar with highlighting (implies textLayer). Ctrl / ⌘ + F focuses it, Enter / Shift + Enter step through matches, Esc clears.
optionDescriptions.source: The document: a URL string or URL, or ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array / Blob / File. null, undefined and '' show the empty state.
optionDescriptions.textLayer: Selectable, copyable text that assistive technology can read.
optionDescriptions.thumbnails: Lazily rendered page thumbnails sidebar, hidden in compact, non-fullscreen mode.
optionDescriptions.toolbar: false hides the toolbar; an object sets position, actions and hiddenWhenCompact.
optionDescriptions.wheelZoom: Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and trackpad pinch zoom, anchored at the pointer.
optionDescriptions.zoomLevels: Preset ladder, e.g. [0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 4]: the zoom buttons step between presets instead of by scaleStep.
optionDescriptions.zoomReset: The zoom label becomes a button that resets zoom.
optionDescriptions.onPageChange: Called whenever the page changes, controlled or not.
optionDescriptions.onFullscreenChange: Called whenever fullscreen is entered or left.
optionDescriptions.className: Added to the root (.rpv-root). rpv-theme-dark and rpv-theme-auto select the dark presets.
optionDescriptions.style: Inline styles on the root, e.g. CSS variables.
